issues.on_page: Solid Waste 9,675.00 under Business-Type Activities, General Fund column
issues.issue: The line is printed under the Business-Type Activities heading but paid from the General Fund. Keeping it governmental is defensible (it has a review note).
The category comes from the fund name only. The row label is Local Receipts: Other.
receipts[12]-[13]: the page has no breakdown, so treating these as utility charges is an assumption. The split_from by fund column is supported because the page prints each fund's amount.
The capital outlay label is not in the 'Capital Outlay: <function>' form, and the page prints no function.
The memo figure for the county treasurer balance is not recorded and not mentioned in the notes.
